title: Lead/Senior Solution Architect - AI Modernisation
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We’re looking for a **Lead/Senior Solution Architect** to join our growing team in India and help design cutting\-edge solutions for global clients.


We are seeking an experienced Lead/Senior professional with deep specialization in AI technologies and Application Modernisation to lead the design and delivery of transformative AI solutions. This role combines technical expertise in AI architecture with practical experience in modernising legacy systems and evolving enterprise platforms.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and develop AI\-driven solutions and agentic platforms that deliver measurable business value
* Lead application modernisation initiatives that incorporate AI technologies to enhance and transform existing systems
* Assess legacy systems and recommend modernisation strategies
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand client requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Implement and optimize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) models for enterprise applications
* Conduct research to stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in AI technologies and modernisation patterns
* Design migration pathways from monolithic to microservices, cloud\-native, or AI\-enabled architectures
* Ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing systems and platforms
* Communicate effectively with clients and stakeholders to present solutions and gather feedback

**Requirements**

* 14\+ years of general IT experience, including proven experience as a Solution Architect, particularly in AI technologies and application modernisation
* Hands\-on experience with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) models in production environments
* Demonstrated expertise in application modernisation, including legacy system assessment, refactoring strategies, and monolith\-to\-microservices transformation
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong research skills to stay abreast of the latest AI trends, modernisation patterns, and technologies
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Proficiency in English at an Upper\-Intermediate level (B2\) or higher

**Nice to have**

* Experience with other AI and machine learning frameworks and tools
* Previous experience in developing agentic platforms
* Familiarity with containerization, orchestration, and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Background in cloud migration and cloud\-native architecture design
* Experience with enterprise integration patterns and middleware technologies

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Senior Consultant Specialist
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist


In this role you will:

* Partner with cross\-functional stakeholders to define, build and implement a Generative AI Agent platform supporting priority banking services from discovery through production rollout.
* Architect enterprise\-grade platform capabilities, including agent orchestration (supervisors/super agents), workflow design, tool/function integration, memory and state management, skill registry/management, and reusable patterns that enable consistent delivery across teams.
* Drive platform adoption at scale by creating reference implementations, onboarding pathways, developer enablement (APIs/SDKs, templates, documentation), and governance that accelerates safe, repeatable delivery of agent solutions.
* Own platform performance management: define success metrics and SLOs, implement observability (logs/metrics/traces), run evaluations, and continuously tune reliability, accuracy, latency and cost to optimise outcomes.
* Oversee end\-to\-end delivery execution, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies and milestones; coordinate across teams to remove blockers and ensure timely, high\-quality outcomes.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, translating technical options into clear recommendations, trade\-offs (value/risk/cost), and delivery plans to support informed decision\-making.
* Stay current on GenAI/agent advancements (including LangChain/LangGraph and emerging alternatives), assess applicability to HSBC use cases, and drive pragmatic upgrades that keep the platform secure, compliant and competitive.


To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements

* Education \& English: Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science/Engineering (or related); strong communication skills including verbal communication in English.
* Software Engineering: 5\+ years’ handon coding practice, strong Python or Golang, with usage of at least one major cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP); ability to deploy and operate services in production (Docker/Kubernetes preferred).
* GenAI / LLM Delivery: 2\+ years building and shipping LLM/GenAI applications; Proven practices with agentic workflows, multi\-agents, and tool/function calling, and RAG, search, and vector databases, design \& develop agent tooling and integration patterns (e.g., MCP and tool/function calling)
* Problem\-solving \& commitment, strong ability to develop creative solutions to complex challenges, working effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrates an AI\-native mindset by applying AI\-driven approaches, including coding assistants, to improve productivity, quality, and engineering best practices.


You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.  

www.hsbc.com/careers


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Engineering Team Lead
description:
**Job Description**
===================

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Engineering Team Lead to oversee a global, cross\-functional team of software engineers and quality assurance engineers, guiding them in the development and delivery of high\-quality software and ensuring projects are completed on time and meet business requirements. This role requires a combination of technical expertise, team management, and the ability to foster a collaborative, results\-driven team culture. The ideal candidate should be a strong communicator with a passion for problem\-solving, mentoring, adoptable and driving continuous improvement within the new engineering process. You have to oversee the development of application code, contribute to and manage version\-controlled source code repositories, and manage assigned tasks to create measurable value and deliver software to market using industry\-recognized best practices. The lead should advocate the standards and guidelines set by the architects and leadership teams and must demonstrate quality, brevity, and timeliness in all deliverables. Technical lead have to raise the team's adoption of AI\-driven engineering practices, and use AI strategically for delivery planning, risk assessment, and productivity gains. You will contribute technically towards the delivery, health, and growth of the entire team.


**A Day in the Life**

In this role, the candidate will:


* Manage a scrum team to deliver project deliverables on time and be the main technical face of the team for any decision.
* Successfully run Agile ceremonies and work closely with Product Owners on keeping the roadmap and the team’s current capacity in balance.
* Help to educate and mentor other engineers, and participate in on\-call duties for production issues as required.
* Develop application code according to requirements and assigned tasks.
* Contribute to lifecycle Flow and value streams by following and prescribing methodologies and best practices.
* Solve the most difficult software development challenges.
* Maintain a balance of business and technical acumen in decision making.
* Contribute to source\-code management and work item tracking best practices.
* Contribute to the estimation process during planning exercises.
* Provide consultation to the development management team.
* Contribute to all phases of the software development lifecycle, including design reviews, writing user stories, reviewing code submitted by other engineers, and automated testing.

**We Are Looking for Someone Who Brings**

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 8\+ years of professional software development experience, with at least 4 years building and supporting .NET Framework/.NET ecosystem\-based applications.
* Has 2\-4 years of experience in managing a scrum team
* Has 2\-4 years of experience developing with the Power Platform / Dynamics 365 / Dataverse

**Must\-have skills**

* Strong knowledge of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) design and principles and is comfortable with working within an established code base.

* A self\-starter who can work independently within a globally distributed team.
* Experience developing RESTful and SOAP APIs.
* Experience with developing middleware and interacting with components such as Azure Service Bus, Azure Function, and Kafka.
* Expertise working with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript / jQuery.
* Experience working in one or more RDBMS such as SQL server and PostgreSQL.
* Agile development experience using a scrum tool such as Jira.
* Experience with Git and version control software such as GitHub or Bitbucket.
* Experience with CI/CD best practices and leveraging GitHub actions or equivalent.
* Authentication and authorization using OpenID Connect, OAuth 2\.0, and/or SAML.
* Understanding of emerging AI technologies and toolsets in support of engineering best practices, such as GitHub Copilot Chat, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.
* Experience with cross\-repository dependency stewardship.
* Experience developing microservices and event\-driven processing.

**Good\-to\-have skills**

* Experience deploying to and managing the cloud; experience with Azure and AWS is a huge plus.
* Experience with performance testing and APMs at the enterprise level.

title: Test Manager, AI
description:
**Overview**The Test Manager \- AI is responsible for leading the organisation's quality engineering and AI testing strategy, driving the adoption of innovative testing practices, intelligent automation, and AI\-enabled quality solutions across the technology landscape. Operating within a complex enterprise environment, the role provides testing leadership across multiple programs, ensuring the delivery of high\-quality, reliable, scalable, and secure solutions that align with business objectives.
This role is accountable for shaping and advancing next\-generation quality engineering capabilities by integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) into the testing lifecycle. The Test Manager \- AI will champion the transformation of traditional testing approaches through the implementation of intelligent, predictive, and self\-optimising testing frameworks that enhance efficiency, quality, and delivery outcomes.
Leading global testing teams and collaborating closely with business and technology stakeholders, the role fosters a culture of quality, innovation, and continuous improvement while driving testing maturity, operational excellence, and the adoption of industry\-leading practices across the organisation.  

  

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**Strategic Focus
* Formulate the strategic vision and technical roadmap for integrating AI and Generative AI into the testing lifecycle. Oversee the deployment of intelligent frameworks optimizing automated test case generation, autonomous test execution, and computer\-vision visual validations.
* Manage and accountable for a Portfolio of programs/projects to ensure successful delivery and taking Business on the quality journey.
* Strong due diligence and analysis skills towards test solution designing.
* Oversee the modernization of scalable enterprise test automation frameworks embedded seamlessly into high\-velocity CI/CD continuous delivery pipelines.
* Deploy AI/ML analytical tools to evaluate historical defect logs, identifying risk patterns, predicting system regressions, and proactively adjusting test focus areas.
* Formulate an effective, practical but robust Test Strategy by coordinating with all relevant stakeholders considering a highly complex financial services environment.
* Assess any quality gaps and keep the stakeholders informed in timely manner and suggest solution to resolve any blockers.
* Identify areas of improvement and establish a continuous improvement process.
Operational Management
* Manage the Full E2E testing lifecycle of assigned projects in a multi\-vendor and in distributed delivery environment.
* Evaluate, proof\-of\-concept, and manage commercial relationships with emerging AI testing vendors, maximizing ROI across tools, frameworks, and resource allocations.
* Review program/project level business requirements, technical specifications, end to end Business Processes and solution design documents, highlighting any gaps or potential improvements.
* Define and deploy defect preventive process and measures in distributed delivery model.
* Defect Management activities (prioritization, including, conducting defect triage meeting with business, technology \& interface partners); work with relevant stakeholders to agree on workaround for outstanding defects and defects resolutions.
* Participate in the planning of UAT, PVT for Programs and Projects (including approach and scope of PVT).
* Facilitates the development, implementation, and adherence of testing department standards in partnership with other test team leaders.
* Establish key performance indicators and quality metrics to measure and report on the effectiveness of the testing process.
* Communicate quality metrics to relevant stakeholders.
* Review reports produced by the testing teams, provide guidance, evolve process, and actively participate in resolving issues/roadblocks to testing progress.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance AI testing frameworks, processes, and automation capabilities.
* Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to project teams on AI testing methodologies, Responsible AI validation, test automation approaches, and emerging industry practices.
* Mentor the testing team and contribute to building AI testing capabilities across teams through coaching, standards adoption, and continuous learning initiatives.
People Leadership
* Support the project team in leveraging testing tools to improve team productivity and effectiveness (Test Management, Defect Management, and Test Automation, Performance Testing, AI Driven Testing).
* Work within a team contributing to:
* Timely delivery of assigned tasks and project outcomes.
* Effective use of technology to solve business challenges and improve operational efficiency.
* Innovation and continuous improvement through the development of practical and scalable solutions.
* Motivate the team to consistently deliver quality results through collaboration, accountability, and innovation.
Governance \& Risk
* Review and sign\-off of testing artefacts (Test Plans and Test Summary Reports), liaising with respective project team members (including Development teams, Test teams, Business, Solution Designers, Architects, IT, PMs, and other stakeholders.)
* Governance and management of vendor achievement against Service Level Agreements, measuring performance against established metrics and evaluating third\-party operations for quality and adherence to agreed schedule and budget requirements to align delivered Services with business \\ IT needs and key stakeholder expectations.
* Manage and document the quality assurance activities with internal reporting and audits.
* Validate adherence to Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and governance standards.
* Conduct and support the assessment and reporting of AI\-related risks, including model bias, explainability, fairness, and data quality concerns.
* Ensure maintenance of appropriate test evidence, validation reports, defect records, and audit documentation to support governance and compliance requirements.
* Escalate risks, issues, and control gaps that may impact AI solution quality, regulatory compliance, or business outcomes.
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time\-to\-time based on business needs.  

  

**Experience \& Personal Attributes**Experience
* Tertiary qualifications in Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline
* 14\+ years of authentic experience in Software Testing, Quality Assurance, and Engineering.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in direct managerial or organizational leadership capacities, directly managing distributed engineering teams in complex E2E integrated financial platform.
* Practical experience utilizing Generative AI models (e.g., OpenAI API, GitHub Copilot) for building intelligent synthetic data, structural test scaffolding, and automating framework maintenance.
* Knowledge or functional experience in testing and handling validation patterns specific to AI/ML software ecosystems.
* Extensive experience in managing a multi\-vendor engagement.
* Extensive experience in building process, practices, and test team in distributed delivery model
* Strong E2E test management background within a fast\-paced business and in complex IT application landscape.
* Strong commercial / business acumen
* Experience in CI/CD pipeline and tools such as Azure Devops
* Accounting/Superannuation/Insurance/BFSI highly desirable.
* Core automation experience in Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress, or Appium.
* Experience in API testing, Mobile, App testing highly desirable.
* Certification in Domain/Testing/Delivery methodology like ISTQB, Agile, ASFA highly desirable
* Working experience working in an Agile scrum environment, expert in JIRA and Confluence or similar tools
* Hands on experience in improving Testing \& QA capabilities with a strong awareness of industry developments and best practice.
* Managing the mobilization and operation of Testing services.
* A strong background in financial services \& pensions industry will be highly advantageous.
Personal Attributes
* Demonstrate strong thought leadership, strategic thinking, and effective communication in driving and uplifting Quality through all stages of the SDLC – and within the Test practice.
* Strong influential skills with an emphasis on building quality output, and continuous improvement
* Effective verbal and written communication skills, needed to communicate with global teams/stakeholders.
* Practical and simple problem\-solving approach.
* Capable of managing high pressure and short timelines, with the willingness to be flexible
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously and prioritize them

title: General Civil UG Designers
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.


**The Role**

***As a General Civil UG Designers with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.


* Develop and manage 3D structural models using Tekla Structures for civil and industrial projects.
* Prepare Structural Steel / Concrete GA drawings, and reinforcement detailing.
* Coordinate with architects, engineers, and project managers to ensure accuracy and compliance with design.
* Perform clash detection, model validation, and quality checks to maintain project integrity.
* Generate material take\-offs (MTOs), BOQs, and reports from Tekla models.
* Ensure adherence to international codes and standards (IS, AISC, BS, Eurocodes, etc.).
* Collaborate with multi\-disciplinary teams to deliver projects within timelines.
* Provide technical support during fabrication and construction phases.
* Maintain and update project documentation and revision control.

**About You**  

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* Experience in shop drawings and fabrication drawings will be added advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree/Diploma/Certificate course in Drafting / Modeling.
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience with Tekla Structures in civil/structural projects.
* Strong knowledge of steel structures, concrete structures, and rebar detailing.
* Familiarity with BIM workflows and integration with other design software (AutoCAD, Revit, Navisworks).
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Experience working in reputed engineering, EPC, or construction companies.
* Preferred Attributes\- Exposure to international and Indian industrial projects.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.


And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
#### **At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA**


Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.
AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto\-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022\. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading \& liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back\-office, product management, technology \& engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.#### **Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)**


At AMINA, we are building practical AI and automation solutions for a regulated banking environment — focused on measurable business value, operational efficiency, and responsible use of technology.  

We are looking for an AI Solution Architect / Engineer to lead the technology side of a dedicated AI squad focused on process automation and AI\-enabled transformation across the bank.  

This role sits at the intersection of AI architecture, process automation, software engineering, cloud platforms, and business problem\-solving. You will work closely with the Process Engineers and process engineering team to understand business processes, identify automation opportunities, and design AI\-powered solutions that are secure, scalable, and production\-ready.  

This is not a passive architecture role. We are looking for someone who is conceptual and hands\-on, able to challenge ideas, shape solution direction, guide engineers, and actively contribute to delivery where needed.#### **Your AMINA To\-Do List**

**Lead the technology side of the AI squad*** Act as the technology lead and solution design owner for AI and automation initiatives.
* Partner closely with the Process Engineers to translate process improvement opportunities into feasible technology solutions.
* Challenge assumptions and ensure that AI is applied only where it creates real value — not as a default solution.
* Help shape the squad’s technical roadmap, delivery approach, and reusable solution patterns.
* Provide technical guidance to AI engineers, full\-stack engineers, and other contributors.

**Design AI and automation solutions*** Design end\-to\-end solutions combining AI models, agentic workflows, APIs, business applications, data sources, and user interfaces.
* Define when to use AI, workflow automation, rule\-based automation, data\-driven solutions, or traditional software engineering.
* Design agentic AI patterns, retrieval\-augmented generation flows, prompt orchestration, tool use, memory handling, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.
* Ensure AI solutions are explainable, traceable, reliable, and suitable for a regulated banking environment.
* Define guardrails, validation mechanisms, fallback paths, monitoring, and escalation points.

**Bridge process engineering and software delivery*** Work with process engineers to understand current\-state processes, target\-state designs, pain points, bottlenecks, and automation potential.
* Translate business and process requirements into solution concepts, architecture decisions, and technical delivery plans.
* Support prioritization of use cases based on feasibility, value, complexity, risk, and reusability.
* Ensure solutions are not built on top of broken processes, but support a disciplined approach to simplification, standardization, and automation.

**Guide engineering delivery*** Support AI / full\-stack engineers in building backend services, frontend interfaces, APIs, integrations, and AI\-enabled workflows.
* Review technical designs, integration patterns, and implementation choices.
* Contribute hands\-on where needed, especially in early solution design, prototypes, technical spikes, and complex integrations.
* Ensure solutions follow sound software engineering practices, including testing, secure design, CI/CD, monitoring, and operational support.

**Work within AMINA’s technology and governance environment*** Design solutions using Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and related enterprise platforms where appropriate.
* Ensure alignment with internal AI governance, security, data protection, software development, change management, and audit expectations.
* Collaborate with Security, SRE, Data Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Data Protection teams where required.
* Support documentation of architecture decisions, risks, controls, and operational responsibilities.

**Keep improving the AI capability*** Stay current with fast\-moving developments in AI, agentic systems, automation tools, and engineering practices.
* Evaluate new AI capabilities, frameworks, orchestration tools, and architectural patterns pragmatically.
* Help build reusable standards, templates, reference architectures, and engineering practices for AI and automation delivery.
* Coach others on responsible, effective, and practical use of AI technologies.

#### **Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:**

**Required experience*** Strong technical background in software engineering, solution architecture, AI engineering, automation, or cloud\-based application delivery.
* Practical understanding of AI solution design, including large language models, prompt engineering, RAG, agents, tool use, model limitations, and evaluation approaches.
* Experience designing systems that integrate with APIs, data sources, enterprise platforms, workflow tools, and business applications.
* Good understanding of cloud architecture, preferably Microsoft Azure.
* Ability to design secure, scalable, maintainable, and production\-ready solutions.
* Strong conceptual thinking combined with the ability to get into technical detail.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams across business, process, engineering, security, and operations.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Strongly preferred*** Experience with process automation, workflow orchestration, or business process transformation.
* Familiarity with process engineering concepts such as Lean, Six Sigma, BPMN, process mining, or value\-stream thinking.
* Hands\-on exposure to AI agents, orchestration frameworks, RAG pipelines, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, n8n, Power Automate, or similar tools.
* Full\-stack engineering understanding, including backend services, frontend applications, APIs, databases, and integration patterns.
* Experience in banking, fintech, financial services, or another regulated environment.
* Familiarity with auditability, traceability, human oversight, access control, logging, and operational resilience requirements.

**Mindset*** Proactive leader, not just a technical expert waiting for requirements.
* Strong sparring partner for process engineering and business stakeholders.
* Curious, hands\-on, and motivated to continuously learn as AI evolves.
* Pragmatic: able to distinguish between what is technically impressive and what creates real business value.
* Comfortable working in ambiguity and shaping structure where none exists yet.
* Strong ownership mindset from concept through production delivery.
* Able to balance innovation, speed, security, governance, and maintainability.


**Tools and technologies**
Azure AI Foundry · LLMs · RAG · Agentic AI · Prompt Engineering · AI Evaluation · Workflow Automation · n8n · Power Automate · APIs · Kotlin · Java · Spring Boot · React · TypeScript · Azure Cloud · Entra ID · SharePoint · Microsoft 365 · CI/CD · Containers · Monitoring · Architecture Documentation#### **Why We’re Awesome**


We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. **Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!**

Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.
